name: Alpe d’Huez (test)
context: Bourg d’Oisans parking to Alpe d’Huez summit arrival, including the valley approach. Ascent only; one traversal.

source.attribution: public/alpe-d-huez.gpx — Cyclo - Alpe d'Huez, la montée mythique; Oisans waypoints

corrections: Trimmed at the first maximum elevation (45.09497, 6.07068), before the return descent.
